task.title: Recover from unsaved changes
task.shortdesc: Avoid losing unsaved editor changes during navigation, tab close, refresh, or mode switching.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: BPM warns about dirty editor state, but users still need to decide whether to save, discard, or stay on the page.

step.cmd: Stop when the browser or BPM reports unsaved changes.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Identify the active tab, profile name, schema channel, and editor mode that contains the draft.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Save the profile if the changes should become the new profile state, or cancel navigation to review them first.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: If you intentionally discard changes, reopen the profile from the Library and confirm the saved state before continuing.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: You either preserve the draft by saving it or knowingly return to the last saved profile state.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
